scope: static, AI-assisted, nothing executed; production diff read line by line, tests skimmed; tripwire, overlap and apply-vs-main triage used
findings: Accepts unmasked D3D12 view instancing on vertex PSOs via Vulkan multiview: enables the multiview feature, carries view_mask into pipelines and dynamic rendering, and checks layer count and max instance index before draws; 116 test lines. Tripwire 'unsafe-c' is a test OMSetRenderTargets call: false positive.

Hardening note: the loop that scans stage.words for Layer/ViewportIndex decorations does 'i += count' with no check for count == 0 or i+count past the end; it would spin or read past the buffer on malformed SPIR-V. Input is the project's own translated shader, so robustness only, not a privilege boundary.
